ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

description:

title: Encarregado de logística
description:
Dover Fueling Solutions ("DFS"), uma empresa Dover (NYSE: DOV) composta pelos negócios Clear View, Fairbanks, Pro Gauge, Tokheim, Wayne Fueling Systems e OPW's Fuel Management Systems, oferece equipamentos avançados de abastecimento de combustíveis, sistemas eletrônicos e pagamento, medição automática de tanques e soluções de gerenciamento de estoque de líquidos para clientes em todo o mundo. Sumário: Coordenar as atividades do setor de logística, distribuir e orientar os serviços do Almoxarifado e Revenda, abrangendo o recebimento e armazenamento de peças nacionais e importadas, garantindo a acuracidade do estoque e os devidos registros de movimentações, acompanhar as atividades de expedição de peças e produtos acabados para o mercado interno e exportação, controlar todo o fluxo do processo de armazenagem dos armazéns internos e externos, coordenar as atividades de separação, embalagem e envio de peças e produtos de automação e intercompany, e processos de reparos eletrônicos com o objetivo de garantir a reposição de peças em campo e buscar soluções para eventuais problemas que possam ocorrer.

Supervisionar a contagem cíclica e acompanhar as devidas análises bem como, tratativas das divergências quando necessário.
Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;

Analisar junto ao time de Sourcing e Qualidade o melhor tipo de embalagem para os produtos recebidos a fim de garantir o melhor uso de espaço do armazém, facilitando assim a conferência, armazenagem e garantindo a conservação do produto durante o transporte e no armazém;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
Participar de reuniões com a área de planejamento referente a programação de produção dos pedidos de revenda e monitorar estoque/itens em almoxarifado de peças fora de linha;
Garantir a continuidade do programa 5 S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato. Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de Revenda
Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
Identificar necessidades prioritárias de expedição de produtos acabados, coordenar a movimentação, armazenamento e organização dos materiais a serem expedidos, e coordenar todo o fluxo de saldos de produtos acabados internamente e em armazéns externos.
Realizar interface / acompanhamento, controles e negociações de prazos com empresas de transporte/correios, bem como elaborar indicador de desempenho de performance de transportadoras;
Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;

Garantir a continuidade do programa 5 S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato. Conhecimentos especificos / Habilidades:

title: Comandante a330
description:
O seu sonho é comandar uma carreira de sucesso diretamente da cabine? Che GOL a hora.
Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuarem como Comandante.
Em seu plano de voo, está prevista uma atuação junto ao Time da Diretoria de Operações, alinhada à estratégia da Companhia e aos regulamentos vigentes, contribuindo para a evolução das nossas operações com os mais altos padrões de Segurança e consistência.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Missão do Cargo
Exercer a autoridade de Comandante desde a apresentação para o voo até a entrega da aeronave ao final da viagem, garantindo a Segurança operacional, a conformidade regulatória e a continuidade das operações e representando a empresa perante passageiros, tripulação e autoridades, em alinhamento ao Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica (CBA) e aos regulamentos vigentes.
Além disso, atuar em integração com os Times da Companhia, contribuindo com sua experiência para o fortalecimento contínuo da operação.
Autoridade
Exercer autoridade plena sobre a aeronave, tripulação, passageiros e carga durante toda a operação;
Recusar aeronave que não esteja em condições aeronavegáveis;
Adiar, suspender ou encerrar o voo quando indispensável à Segurança;
Recusar embarque ou determinar desembarque de pessoas que comprometam a Segurança ou a disciplina a bordo;
Adotar medidas necessárias à proteção da aeronave, das pessoas e dos bens transportados;
Representar o Administrador da empresa durante toda a viagem;
Atuar em ocorrências relacionadas a atos ilícitos (AVSEC), mantendo comunicação com os órgãos de controle;
Contratar manutenção extraordinária, quando necessário;
Validar licenças e certificados, conforme prerrogativa da autoridade aeronáutica.
Segurança Operacional
Garantir a Segurança de tripulantes, passageiros e carga do fechamento das portas até o desembarque final;
Assegurar as condições de aeronavegabilidade, peso e balanceamento;
Certificar-se da correta quantidade de combustível e monitorar seu consumo;
Avaliar as condições meteorológicas, NOTAMs e dos aeródromos;
Garantir que o voo esteja devidamente despachado junto ao DOV.;
Assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos do Programa de Segurança do Operador Aéreo;
Reportar condições inseguras aos órgãos de controle e à área de Safety;
Identificar e reportar perigos operacionais por meio do sistema oficial da empresa.
Gestão da Tripulação
Assegurar a subordinação técnica e disciplinar da tripulação;
Delegar atribuições, exceto aquelas relacionadas à Segurança do voo;
Definir o Pilot Flying e garantir a execução correta dos checklists;
Garantir que apenas atividades essenciais sejam realizadas em fases críticas do voo;
Zelar pelo cumprimento da regulamentação profissional, incluindo jornada, repouso e limites operacionais.
Conformidade e Registros
Preencher ou assegurar o correto preenchimento do Diário de Bordo e do Relatório Técnico da Aeronave;
Registrar ocorrências que demandem inspeção obrigatória, como pouso duro, turbulência severa, tail strike, RTO, incidência de raio e excedentes de limites operacionais;
Assegurar os registros de ocorrências a bordo, incluindo eventos médicos, nascimentos e óbitos, conforme regulamentação aplicável;
Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de Segurança Operacional (SGSO) e da Política Ambiental.
Cabine e Passageiros
Assegurar a transmissão das instruções de Segurança;
Garantir o cumprimento das normas de Segurança em situações normais, de emergência e em evacuação;
Assegurar a integridade e a Segurança da cabine de comando;
Garantir a correta utilização dos equipamentos de emergência.
Não pode faltar em sua bagagem:
Formação
Ensino Médio completo (Ensino Superior é um diferencial)
Experiência superior na função

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us! We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.
About Us Innovators in Simulation Technology CMG (TSX: CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

Construir operações de transporte confiáveis e competitivas em custos.

Desenvolver, implementar e acompanhar KPIs de logística, contribuindo para iniciativas de melhoria contínua nos processos logísticos.
Conduzir e liderar projetos de melhoria contínua.
Elaborar Mapas de Fluxo de Valor (Value Stream Maps) e coordenar iniciativas Kaizen.
Transformar o departamento de Logística de transacional para tático e, posteriormente, de tático para estratégico.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
• Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
• Advanced English (spoken and written),
• Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
• Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
• Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
• High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
• Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
• Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
• Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
• Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
• Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
• Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
• Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
• Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• Hybrid working model,
• One day off on your birthday,
• Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
• Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
• Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
• Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
• Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
• Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our " One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Coordenador(a) obra
description:
Descrição da vaga
Buscamos Coordenador(a) de Obras para atuar na gestão e coordenação de obras imobiliárias, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos, custos, qualidade, segurança e sustentabilidade, em conformidade com projetos, contratos, legislação vigente e práticas ESG.
Este profissional terá papel fundamental na liderança das equipes de obra e na consolidação de um ambiente seguro, ético e alinhado aos Sistemas de Gestão Integrados.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Coordenar a execução das obras, assegurando aderência ao cronograma físico-financeiro, orçamento e padrões de qualidade;
Liderar equipes próprias e terceirizadas, promovendo produtividade, organização e alinhamento técnico;
Atuar como elo entre engenharia, suprimentos, segurança do trabalho, qualidade e planejamento e controle;
Controlar medições, relatórios de avanço físico, contratos com fornecedores e empreiteiros;
Garantir o cumprimento das legislações trabalhistas, ambientais e urbanísticas aplicáveis ao empreendimento;
Apoiar o relacionamento com clientes, fiscalizações e demais stakeholders da obra;
Assegurar o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicáveis;
Atuar preventivamente na identificação e mitigação de riscos no canteiro de obras;
Trabalhar em parceria com a área de Segurança do Trabalho na análise de incidentes e implantação de ações corretivas e preventivas;
Garantir a aplicação dos requisitos dos Sistemas de Gestão Integrados;
Assegurar padronização de processos, controle documental e registros técnicos da obra;
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas;
Implementar e acompanhar práticas alinhadas aos princípios ESG;
Contribuir para a disseminação de uma cultura de responsabilidade socioambiental no canteiro. Requisitos e qualificações
Graduação completa em Engenharia Civil;
CREA ativo;
Experiência prévia em coordenação de obras residenciais no mercado imobiliário;
Conhecimento em planejamento, controle de custos, leitura e interpretação de projetos;
Vivência com Segurança do Trabalho, ESG e normas ISO;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão e planejamento (MS Project, Excel, Auto CAD; BIM será um diferencial). Competências comportamentais
Liderança e capacidade de tomada de decisão;
Organização e visão sistêmica;
Comunicação clara e postura ética;
Foco em resultados, segurança e sustentabilidade;
Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e sob pressão. Informações adicionais
Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca
Regime de contratação: CLT

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world. As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees. On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us!
Job challenges:
- Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT;
- Monitor, and enforce KNOT's HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation;
- Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements;
- Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace;
- Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses;
- Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits;
- Participate in emergency response drills and simulations;
- Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures;
Requirements:
- Technical degree in Occupational Safety;
- Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry;
- Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested;
- Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs);
- Intermediate Excel skills;
- Desirable: Bachelor's degree;
- Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer:
- Food allowance;
- Transportation allowance without discount;
- Health and dental plan at no cost;
- Life insurance;
- Private pension;
- Profit-Sharing;
- Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

Atendimento a clientes por telefone, Whats App e e-mail (informações, esclarecimento de dúvidas e pós-venda);
Prospecção e qualificação de leads, com foco em recuperação de clientes inativos e ações de cross selling;

Suporte direto à equipe de vendas nas atividades diárias, atuando como ponte entre o cliente e o time comercial;

Participação em reuniões de alinhamento com o time comercial, contribuindo com insights sobre leads e oportunidades de conversão. Crescimento :
Possibilidade real de efetivação
Histórico de efetivação em curto prazo
Após efetivação: CLT + benefícios + ganhos variáveis Perfil buscado:
Interesse em negócios e ambiente corporativo
Boa comunicação, organização e responsabilidade
Conforto com metas e indicadores
Vontade real de aprender e crescer

title: Oficial de quarto de nautica
description:
Oportunidade Offshore – Oficial de Nautica
Estamos com vaga aberta para Oficial de Nautica para atuação em embarcação offshore.
Buscamos profissionais comprometidos com segurança, disciplina operacional e excelência técnica, que queiram contribuir para a confiabilidade das operações e para o bom desempenho da embarcação.

• Integrar o Quarto de Navegação de bordo;
• Substituir o Oficial de Náutica do Quarto de Navegação e o Imediato em seus impedimentos legais;
• Auxiliar em todas as manobras da embarcação, conforme orientação do Comandante;
• Ser responsável pelo regimento de sinais e bandeiras, artefatos pirotécnicos, lanternas e outros sinais de emergência;

• 2 ON
• Cursos obrigatórios (STCW) atualizados

title: Meitu campus ambassador (analytics track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship
We're looking for Campus Strategy Analysts! You will help us decode user behavior, spot local trends, and turn campus-level data insights into business decisions that shape products for millions of young users worldwide.
What you'll do:
● Observe local trends: Track how AI and imaging apps are used around you—what's hot, what's not. Run surveys, conduct interviews, and gather real data to give our global strategy a local voice.
● Analyze user behavior: Go deep into how your peers interact with visual tech. Spot pain points, map user journeys, and propose clear, actionable improvements—backed by data.
● Co-create user profiles: Help us build smarter user models. Use text mining or simple AI tools to analyze interviews, social comments, and feedback—turning raw input into refined insights.

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Technical implementation specialist
description:
Why Kodif?
At Kodif, we're transforming how customers interact with e Commerce brands. From shopping to support to retention, we're building agentic AI systems that make every website interaction personalized, instant, and human-like — redefining the modern customer journey.
Highlights:
Our team comes from Uber, Meta, Stanford, and Walmart. Our CTO built Uber's customer support platform.
We're backed by Bling Capital, SNR (Kevin Mahaffey), and Village Global (backed by Jeff Bezos, Bill Gates, and Reid Hoffman), with $9 M raised to date.
We're trusted by leading e Commerce brands like Dollar Shave Club, Liquid I. V., Trust Wallet, and Alma. Our Culture & Values:
At Kodif, our values guide how we work, what we build, and how we grow together:
Make It Simple – Build systems that are clear, reliable, and scalable.
Superhuman Speed ️ – Move fast and own the outcome — design, build, and deploy in days, not weeks.
Extreme Ownership – Take end-to-end responsibility for delivering impact, not just features.
Customer Crazy – We obsess over creating delightful, human-like AI experiences for our customers.
Two Steps Ahead – Anticipate issues before they surface. Design for the future.
Row Together – Collaborate, communicate, and ship together — success at Kodif is a team sport. Position Overview:
The Technical Implementation Specialist focuses on implementation of AI automation workflows, technical troubleshooting, product behavior analysis, and technical issue resolution. This role combines proactive customer management with technical troubleshooting, enabling Kodif's customers to maximize the value of our platform.
The Implementation Specialist will work cross-functionally to resolve issues, identify risks, and help customers succeed with the Kodif platform.
Responsibilities:
Partner with customers to align product adoption strategies with business goals.
Monitor customer communication channels to identify issues, resolve them, and escalate to Tier 2 technical support when needed.
Identify and mitigate risks related to usage, adoption, or critical defects by creating and executing targeted action plans.
Initiate and manage escalation processes, coordinating communication between customers and internal teams.
Support post-mortem analyses for escalations or major incidents.
Relay customer feedback to product and engineering to influence roadmap priorities.
Address concerns early to reduce churn risk and support long-term retention.
Support internal teams with technical insights and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to documentation, troubleshooting guides, and product improvements. Requirements:
Experience in Support, Implementation, or Customer Success (preferably in AI or CX Saa S).
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills (no coding required).
Strong technical acumen and ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of building trust and advocating for customers.
Experience with ticketing systems, Slack-based support, or similar communication tools.
Experience with LLM prompting.
Ability to read and interpret JSON (e.g., identify failed integration calls and relevant fields). Nice to have:
Ability to interpret SQL-level data and database-driven summaries (light query writing may be required).
Ability to read Python-related error messages and escalate appropriately (no direct coding required). Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary based on location and work experience.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, product, and customer experience with real business impact.
Opportunity to build one of the most impactful AI systems in e Commerce. To be considered, please complete this short application form (2–3 minutes): YYr6 UDG4m RB9 SMt9 and then apply here as well.

title: Técnico de serviços em maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.
A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:
Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.
Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:
• Radares
• ECDIS
• Satcoms
• Rádios HF e VHF
• GPS
• Girobússola
• Pilotos automáticos
• Sirenes
Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:
• Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
• Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
• Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
• Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
• Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.
• Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.
Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Accounting manager
description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Salesforce administrator
description:
Position Overview:
As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‐generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‐first operations, and AI‐driven decision‐making across the organization.
You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.
Responsibilities:
Administers day‐to‐day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
Partners with cross‐functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‐powered workflow automations.
Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‐channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
Ensures secure, least‐privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‐scaling teams.
Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‐to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance. Position Requirements:
4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‐level or high‐velocity environment.
Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel. Additional Requirements:
Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‐functional GTM operations.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
Hands‐on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‐moving, high‐growth environment.

Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps

title: Consultor(a) de investimentos associado(a)
description:
Se você já atua no mercado financeiro e procura a melhor estrutura para atender seus clientes sem conflito de interesses, com boas perspectivas de carreira e sendo bem remunerado, essa vaga é para você!
Somos uma consultoria de investimentos que atende famílias em busca do crescimento patrimonial e da preservação do legado. Atendemos clientes em todos os grandes bancos e corretoras do Brasil e também nos EUA. Nosso modelo de atuação é 100% FEE BASED sem conflito de interesses.

EXPERIÊNCIA: Temos um time experiente e com metodologia proprietária que ajuda na conversão de leads (90%) e retenção de clientes (churn menor que 0,50% ao ano).
CARREIRA: Nosso programa de partnership garante que você tenha oportunidade de aumentar sua participação societária no nosso grupo empresarial na medida em que seus resultados e contribuições cresçam. Nossa empresa também possui uma corretora de seguros completa (Monte Bianco Insurance) e uma área com soluções Corporate que atende PJ com empréstimos, cambio, energia e antecipação de recebíveis. Ou seja, aqui você pode oferecer uma oferta completa de produtos e serviços para seus clientes.
Essa proposta de valor em conjunto com nossa metodologia exclusiva tem resultado em mais de 90% de taxa de conversão de leads em clientes.
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes da área de investimentos para ampliar a equipe da Monte Bianco Multi-Family Office (MBM) no Rio de Janeiro. Este cargo demanda a realização de recomendações financeiras especializadas, gerenciamento de carteiras de investimento e interação contínua com clientes para entender suas necessidades e objetivos financeiros. As responsabilidades diárias incluem análise de tendências de mercado, identificação de oportunidades de investimento e fornecimento de um serviço ao cliente de alta qualidade.
Qualificações
Investimentos e Finanças: necessário ter experiência prévia em atender clientes no mercado financeiro.
Relacionamento: garantir que as necessidades dos clientes sejam compreendidas e atendidas de maneira eficaz.
Prospecção: captação ativa de novos leads e desenvolvimento da estratégias para conversão Caso o candidato não possua nenhuma das certificações exigidas (CEA/CFP/CNPI), será concedido um prazo de 6 meses para que consiga se certificar.

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Risk management officer
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.
Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.
As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.
Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:

As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA
Title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations
Company: Fulcrum Saa S
Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)
Type: Full-time
Level:  Senior / Staff
Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location
About Fulcrum Saa S
Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.
Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.
The Role
We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.
You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.
You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.
What You’ll Do
Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.
What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)
5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).
Strong Nice-to-Haves
Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.
What We Offer
Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.
How to Apply
Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:
Your experience with Go in production.
The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas.
